releases.notes:
New update for **Hyperglide** with support for Minecraft **1.21.4** and **1.21.11**.

## Added

- Baritone assistance for **Auto Pilot** to reduce getting stuck when climbing with blocks
- **Safety Buffer** to **Auto Web** to keep cobweb placements farther away from the player
- **Latency Offset** to **Control Fly** to better account for ping when timing rocket boosts

## Changed

- **Auto Pilot** received several improvements:
  - Refined the initial startup to always equip the elytra for takeoff when using **Spoof Mode** option
  - Added open-area searching for initial takeoff to avoid starting the flight inside enclosed spaces
  - Expanded open-area searching to reduce cases where no reliable launch position can be found
  - Refined highway exits to clear the full blocking column before safely returning to normal flight
- **Elytra Tweaks** received several recovery improvements:
  - Added a notification when using the toggle key for **Spoof Mode** to show the current state
  - Replaced **Collision Ticks** with **Scan Distance** for more practical collision lookahead control
  - Improved recovery to wait for a stable and safe path before resuming normal movement
  - Refined recovery to follow input from **Control Fly** and remain stopped until path is clear
- Adjusted **Control Fly** compatibility so that **Hyperglide** and **BepHax** versions can load together
- Modified the default values and ranges of **Maximum Speed** and **Minimum Speed** in **Control Fly**
- **Overview** now prefers larger item counts when multiple contents occupy the same number of slots
- Revamped **Safety Delta** in **Rocket Boost** with timing adjustment (in milliseconds) for rocket boosts
- Refactored much of the codebase to improve structure and consistency, including simplification

## Fixed

- Removed artificial velocity adjustment in **Control Fly** that could trigger anti-cheat corrections
- Collision avoidance in **Elytra Tweaks** no longer interferes with **Auto Pilot** or **Bounce Fly** module
- Fixed a delayed rocket retry in **Elytra Tweaks** when the toggle-key option failed to use a firework
- **Spoof Mode** option no longer prevents some modules from starting correctly while it is enabled

releases.notes:
New update for **Hyperglide** with support for Minecraft **1.21.4** and **1.21.11**.

## Removed

- Removed **Reload Map** from **Navigation** as routing updates are now fully automatic

## Changed

- Added obstacle mining when **Bounce Fly** recovers from movement interruptions
- Increased movement timeout in **Auto Pilot** when crossing or leaving the highway
- Increased trail clearance in **Bounce Fly** from 2 to 3 blocks high to reduce stuttering
- Updated **Navigation** to keep all highways visible on the map while using **Clip Radius**

## Fixed

- Fixed **Bounce Fly** to prioritize highways at Y=120 over other equally obstructed levels
- Fixed **Elytra Tweaks** sometimes losing the flight control after triggering a firework use
- Fixed firework usage unnecessarily swapping the offhand item when starting a boost

releases.notes:
New update for **Hyperglide** with support for Minecraft **1.21.4** and **1.21.11**.

## Added

- Added **Clip Radius** to **Navigation** for cutting highway segments within spawn range
- Added another **Toggle Key** to **Elytra Tweaks** for switching **Spoof Mode** while flying

## Removed

- Removed **No Gravity** from **Control Fly** since altitude is now handled automatically

## Changed

- Temporarily disabled **Spoof Mode** for **Bounce Fly** (it required **ViaFabricPlus** to work)
- Improved **Bounce Fly** to detect more cases where bounce movement has stopped
- Improved flight behaviour in **Control Fly** for smoother and more stable movement
- Renamed options: **Retry Cooldown** to **Retry Timeout** and **Attack Delay** to **Hit Delay**
- Simplified all interactions in **Easy Access** and cleaned up some parts of the codebase

## Fixed
- Prevented **Control Fly** from using multiple rockets at once when trying to boost
- Fixed switching off **Spoof Mode** while flying to prevent the player from falling

## Notes

- After changing **Clip Radius**, press the **Reload Map** button to rebuild the highway network
- The clipped area is visible on the map and its color can be configured under **Colors** group
